findings.evidence: Tensors/Basic.lean:86 `namespace Bilin` (inside `namespace Tensors`) vs Kinematics/Basic.lean:35 `namespace Bilin`; Tensors/Basic.lean:174 had to be written as `Kinematics.Bilin.apply_sub_smul_pair` to cross the split.
findings.fix: Put the general form API in one namespace: move `rankOne`, `IsIsometry`, `reflect` and their lemmas from `Tensors.Bilin` into `Kinematics.Bilin` (Tensors/Basic.lean already imports Kinematics/Basic.lean), deleting the second namespace rather than keeping both.
findings.issue: This PR opens a second `Bilin` namespace (`...DIS.Kinematics.Bilin`: apply_sub_smul_pair, projOrthogonal and its lemmas) while a `Bilin` namespace for the same type already exists at `...DIS.Tensors.Bilin` (rankOne, IsIsometry, reflect, Tensors/Basic.lean:86). A consumer cannot reach the whole `Bilin` API by opening one namespace, and `Bilin.foo`/dot-notation resolves to whichever is in scope.

findings.evidence: Kinematics/Basic.lean:63-82 (no attributes) vs Jets/Frame/Basic.lean:134-153 (`@[simp]` on the identical statements specialized to `F.n`); Longitudinal.lean:185 rewrites with `projOrthogonal_pairing` by hand.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp]` to the three general lemmas; the `g u u ≠ 0` side condition is dischargeable and simply blocks firing where it is unknown.
findings.issue: `projOrthogonal_orthogonal` (:64), `projOrthogonal_apply_self` (:69) and `projOrthogonal_projOrthogonal` (:80) carry no `@[simp]`, while their Frame specializations `spatial_orthogonal_n`, `spatial_n`, `spatial_spatial` (Jets/Frame/Basic.lean:134,143,151) all do. Direct users of the projection (`pTransverse`, and §1.2's Breit frame along `q`) get none of that automation and must `rw` manually.

summary: The Frame surface itself is sound: minimal fields, derivable @[ext], unexposed bodies, and a complete set of _def/_apply/ker/range/massless restatements. Two problems in the new general Bilin layer: the API for Bilin V is now split across two namespaces of the same leaf name, and the general projection lemmas lack the @[simp] annotations their Frame specializations carry.
